question: In a drama, Hima spoke “Swaraj is my birth right and I shall have it.’’. Which Indian freedom fighter gave this slogan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bal Gangadhar Tilak.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The slogan** "Swaraj is my birthright and I shall have it" **was famously spoken by **Bal Gangadhar Tilak.**
 
• He was **one of the prominent leaders** of the Indian independence movement.
 
• Tilak was an **influential figure in the late 19th and early 20th centuries** and played a crucial role in mobilizing people against British colonial rule in India.
 
• His slogan became a rallying cry for India's struggle for self-rule and was widely embraced by freedom fighters and nationalists during that
